findings.issue: The base URL is escaped twice: `replace(/"/g, "\\\"")` is applied and then the result is passed to `JSON.stringify`, which adds another layer of quotes. The generated script sets `window.__OMNIBRIDGE_BASE_URL__` to a string that includes literal quote characters, breaking client‑side requests.

API routes are defined without a leading slash (e.g., `"api/v1/chat/completions"`). This makes them relative to the current route hierarchy, causing them to be unreachable or resolve to unexpected URLs.
findings.fix:
Add a leading slash to all API route paths:
```ts
export default [
  index("routes/landing.tsx"),
  route("/auth", "routes/auth.tsx"),
  route("/logout", "routes/logout.tsx"),
  route("/api/v1/chat/completions", "routes/api.v1.chat.completions.ts"),
  route("/api/v1/models", "routes/api.v1.models.ts"),
  // ... rest unchanged
] satisfies RouteConfig;
```
